title: SRE weekly snapshot — pocket notes
content:
Purpose / quick goal:
- Prep for weekly ops sync (30m). Surface any SLO regressions, hot paging trends, and top incidents to discuss mitigation and rollouts.

Topline metrics (quick numbers to call out):
- Error budget burn (last 7d): 8.7% of monthly budget (alert threshold 10%). Trending up last 3 days after a small cache regression.
- P95 latency (text-gen small models): 210ms (target <=200ms). Top contributor: a spike in tail latencies during 11:30–13:00 UTC on 07/22.
- Paging volume (weekly): 46 total pages, ~+18% wk/wk. Noise mostly from infra-autoscaler flapping and a downstream error spike.
- Infra capacity headroom: Dedicated pool avg util 68%, burst reserve still available but slow GPUD activations observed (see INC-2026-07-22-01).

Paging trends (what I'm seeing):
- Flapping autoscaler events (SRE-412): repeated scale-up/scale-down due to mis-estimate of in-flight requests; correlated with 429s from router. Root cause appears to be recent tuning change to concurrency cap.
- App-level 5xx bursts: not sustained, often tied to model container restarts after OOMs on quantized models (low frequency). Need to validate memory accounting after recent quant build.
- Alert fatigue: ~30% of pages are duplicates for the same underlying event (alert dedupe rules need refinement).

Top incidents to call out (short bullets):
1) INC-2026-07-22-01: slow GPU activation path during burst; cold-starts took 40–90s causing request timeouts. Workaround: manual warm pool bump. Next: automated warm pool pre-warming and fallback to smaller model variant.
2) INC-2026-07-19-02: autoscaler oscillation causing transient 429s; likely from concurrency cap change (PR infra#218). Partial rollback reduced pages.
3) INC-2026-07-16-05: OOMs on quantized model variant leading to container restarts; happened twice during a long prompt job. Need postmortem? low customer impact but repeated.

Runbook / tooling gaps (notes):
- Warm pool playbook is incomplete: missing steps for increasing warm pool in private deployments. Document a safe ramp procedure.
- Oncall checklist doesn't include a quick memory vs. OOM triage for quantized models — add shell commands and a quick dashboard link.
- Alert dedupe logic: add correlation key based on model_id+route+region to reduce duplicate pages.

Agenda for sync (30m):
- 0–5m: quick metric callout (Maya)
- 5–12m: incident highlights and short status updates (owners)
- 12–20m: proposed mitigations (warm pool, autoscaler tweak, dedupe) and risk tradeoffs
- 20–28m: action item assignment + timelines
- 28–30m: parking lot and FYI items

Talking points / scripts for meeting:
- "Error budget is safe today but trending; main lever is fixing autoscaler flapping which both reduces latency and pages."
- "We should prioritize a short mitigation (tweak concurrency) and a medium-term fix (pre-warm/refactor activation path)."
- "Dedupe will reduce noise quickly and is low-risk — propose we ship this week as a config change."

Action items (capture, owner, due):
- A1: Roll back concurrency cap tweak in canary and monitor (owner: Liam O'Connor) — due 2026-07-25
- A2: Implement alert dedupe key (model_id+route+region) and deploy to staging (owner: Priya Singh) — due 2026-07-27
- A3: Draft warm-pool prewarm playbook for private deployments (owner: Maya Chen) — due 2026-07-30
- A4: Add OOM triage steps and commands to oncall runbook; add dashboard link (owner: oncall) — due 2026-07-28
- A5: Post-incident follow-up for INC-2026-07-22-01: owner to collect activation traces and timeline (owner: SRE-rotation) — due 2026-07-26

Notes to self / heuristics to remember during meeting:
- Keep focus on low-effort high-impact (dedupe and rollback first).
- If proposed change increases P95 beyond 5%, pause and revert.
- Confirm customers affected (use ticket tags) before escalating.

Open questions / blockers:
- Do we have capacity to pre-warm for the top 10% of peak models without breaking committed SLAs for dedicated customers? (need infra input)
- Are there any other recent infra PRs that touched autoscaler config aside from infra#218? (check git history)

Prep checklist (quick):
- Pull last 7d error budget graph from dashboard (Confluence link above) — done
- Confirm owners for the 3 incidents — partial (need SRE-rotation confirmation)
- Add dedupe proposal doc link to meeting invite — todo

Quick logs / commands to paste in meeting if asked:
- kubectl logs -n infra deployment/autoscaler --since=2h | grep -i scale
- curl https://metrics.redwood.ai/api/queries?metric=error_budget_burn&window=7d
- gcloud compute instances list --filter="name~'warm-pool'"

Misc (brain dump):
- Consider adding a small canary that routes 1% of traffic to the fallback smaller-variant model for high-latency events. Low-risk, could flatten p99 spikes.
- Follow up with Product on whether we can expose a degraded-mode SLA (cheaper smaller model variant) for non-critical customers — might be a commercial lever.

End of pocket notes. Will refine into slide deck if leadership wants a short readout.
